messages:
Marta R: Quick sync — we need the release notes draft for today
Eli T: grabbing it now. which PR is the source of truth? link?
Marta R: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/982 — main: adaptive-routing note, streaming-embeddings deprecation, JS SDK snippet cleanup
Samir P: I can update the JS snippet. question: call out fallback policy change under Notable changes or only in migration notes?
Marta R: Put it under Notable changes — two lines. migration guide link stays in migration section
Eli T: draft whats-new (edit freely):
- Improved adaptive routing to lower tail latency and cost under bursty traffic.
- Streaming embeddings API deprecated — see migration steps.
- JS/Go SDK snippet updates for improved retry semantics and function-call examples.
Jules: 1-liner known issue: "Limited TTL on prefix cache may cause slight quality regressions on very long sessions when cached KV spans rollouts."
Samir P: pushed JS snippet in PR 985, added streaming->polling migration example:
```js
// old streaming embeddings
const stream = client.embeddings.stream({input: "..."});
// new polling pattern
const job = await client.embeddings.create({input: "...", mode: "batch"});
const result = await client.embeddings.poll(job.id);
```
Marta R: add one-line compatibility note: "Batch mode preserves ordering but increases latency for single-request usage."
Samir P: added
Eli T: added blurb to PR description and docs/whats-new/v1.4.0.md — can someone proof?
Marta R: tightened bullets, added migration guide link: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate/streaming-to-polling
Jules: release-bot flagged a broken anchor in migration guide (xref #polling-behavior). I fixed it (commit c7f2)
Marta R: release checklist: final proof of whats-new (Eli/Marta), confirm SDK snippets updated in JS/Python/Go (Samir/Jen/—), add known-issues to changelog (Jules), tag internal digest for CS/SRE (Marta) :calendar:
Eli T: grammar tweak pushed. LGTM
Samir P: pinging @Jen P for Python snippet mirror
Jen P: mirroring Python snippet in PR 990, names aligned with client.poll API. added one-line migration tip for Dedicated: "If on Dedicated, fallback policies are configurable — consider conservative thresholds during rollout."
Marta R: Looks good. I'll merge after CI and schedule docs publish for 17:30 PT. Thanks everyone :rocket:
